```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
dir.create("../figures", showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

library(tidyverse)
library(ggdendro)
library(patchwork)
```

## Load and validate the processed data

```{r load-data}
abundance <- read.csv(
  "../data/supp_4.csv",
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
  row.names = 1,
  check.names = FALSE
)

bray_curtis_distance <- read.csv(
  "../data/bray_curtis_distance.csv",
  row.names = 1,
  check.names = FALSE
)

metadata_cols <- c("sample_id", "clinical_response", "time")
missing_metadata <- setdiff(metadata_cols, colnames(abundance))
if (length(missing_metadata)) {
  stop("Missing metadata columns: ", paste(missing_metadata, collapse = ", "))
}

sample_ids <- abundance$sample_id
missing_distances <- setdiff(
  sample_ids,
  intersect(rownames(bray_curtis_distance), colnames(bray_curtis_distance))
)
if (length(missing_distances)) {
  stop("Samples missing from the Bray-Curtis matrix: ",
       paste(missing_distances, collapse = ", "))
}

bray_curtis_distance <- bray_curtis_distance[
  sample_ids,
  sample_ids,
  drop = FALSE
]

meta <- abundance %>%
  transmute(
    label = sample_id,
    group_plot = case_when(
      clinical_response == "donor" ~ "donor",
      time == "T0" ~ "recipient T0",
      time == "T6" & clinical_response == "responder" ~
        "recipient T6 responder",
      time == "T6" & clinical_response == "non-responder" ~
        "recipient T6 non-responder",
      TRUE ~ "other"
    )
  )

hc <- hclust(as.dist(as.matrix(bray_curtis_distance)), method = "ward.D2")
```

## Supplementary Figure 4

```{r supplementary-figure-4, fig.width=10, fig.height=14}
composition_cols <- setdiff(colnames(abundance), metadata_cols)

taxonomies <- abundance %>%
  select(sample_id, all_of(composition_cols)) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(composition_cols),
    names_to = "Taxon",
    values_to = "Abundance"
  ) %>%
  filter(is.finite(Abundance), Abundance > 0) %>%
  transmute(
    id = sample_id,
    Taxon,
    Abundance = Abundance * 100
  )

sample_order <- hc$labels[hc$order]
meta <- meta %>%
  mutate(
    sample_id = factor(label, levels = sample_order),
    x = match(label, sample_order)
  )
taxonomies <- taxonomies %>%
  mutate(id = factor(id, levels = sample_order))

dendrogram_segments <- ggdendro::segment(
  ggdendro::dendro_data(hc, type = "rectangle")
)

group_colors <- c(
    "donor" = "#1b9e77",
    "recipient T0" = "#7570b3",
    "recipient T6 responder" = "#d95f02",
    "recipient T6 non-responder" = "#e7298a",
    "other" = "grey70"
)

tree_plot <- ggplot(dendrogram_segments) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = x, y = y, xend = xend, yend = yend)) +
  geom_point(
    data = meta,
    aes(x = x, y = 0, color = group_plot),
    size = 2.5,
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = group_colors, name = "Sample group") +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0.5, length(sample_order) + 0.5)) +
  labs(y = "Clustering height") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank()
  )

composition_plot <- ggplot(
  taxonomies,
  aes(x = id, y = Abundance, fill = Taxon)
) +
  geom_col(width = 1, color = "black", linewidth = 0.1) +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(option = "turbo", end = 0.9) +
  labs(x = "Sample", y = "Relative abundance (%)", fill = "Phylum") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5, size = 5)
  )

supplementary_figure_4 <- tree_plot / composition_plot +
  plot_layout(heights = c(1, 2), guides = "collect") +
  plot_annotation(title = "Supplementary Figure 4")

supplementary_figure_4

ggsave(
  filename = "../figures/supplementary_figure_4.png",
  plot = supplementary_figure_4,
  width = 10,
  height = 14,
  dpi = 600,
  bg = "white"
)
```
